caseNameFull: MICHAEL F. MANGAN, ADMINISTRATOR OF MARY E. PILLOW v. United States
syllabus:
Judgment- was rendered in favor of the United States in the court below. On appeal the judgment was affirmed, and the Supreme Court decided:

To establish a claim under Judicial Code, section 162. to the proceeds of property seized by the Government under the abandoned property act of March 12, 1863, the claimant must prove his ownership at the time of seizure.

opinions.author: Clakke
opinions.text:
Mr. Justice Clakke

delivered the opinion of the Supreme Court January 3, 1921.
